summary: Completed testing of Cashier Loyalty Points Entry feature (Sprint Loyalty-Cashier). Backend APIs are fully functional (100% pass rate). Frontend has authentication token issue preventing cashier lookup API calls (401 Unauthorized). Phone login tab UI is implemented correctly but end-to-end flow not fully tested due to auth issue.

integration_issues.issue: Cashier lookup API call returns 401 Unauthorized when called from frontend
integration_issues.details: API endpoint /api/outlet/loyalty/cashier/lookup returns 401 when called from the Loyalty Points Entry page. The issue is that the component uses localStorage.getItem('aurora_token') for authorization header, but the token might not be properly stored or accessible after login flow through portal-select.
integration_issues.suggested_fix: Verify that the auth token is properly stored in localStorage as 'aurora_token' after login. The useAuth hook might be storing it under a different key. Check auth.jsx context and ensure token persistence.

items.issue: Frontend authentication token not accessible in LoyaltyPointsEntry component
items.details: The component at line 46 in LoyaltyPointsEntry.jsx uses localStorage.getItem('aurora_token') but the API call returns 401. Need to verify token storage key and ensure it's properly set after login.
items.suggested_fix: Check if useAuth hook stores token under different key. Update line 46 and line 359 to use the correct token retrieval method. Consider using the useAuth hook's token property instead of direct localStorage access.

items.issue: Test end-to-end flow after auth fix
items.details: Once auth token issue is fixed, need to verify: 1) Cashier can search for new customer phone, 2) System shows 'Pelanggan Baru' card, 3) Cashier can add points, 4) Success screen shows correct points, 5) Customer can login via Phone tab with phone as password, 6) Points visible in loyalty dashboard
